title: Expedited Build Price List for Factory Production Orders
content:
An expedited build shortens the time to ship for Factory Production Orders. It is offered in some build classes only.

| Build class | Expedite available | Expedite lead time (business days from the request date to the expedited target ship date) | Expedite fee per unit (USD) | Smallest expedite fee per order (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | Yes | 12 | 45.00 | 195.00 |
| Custom Color Build | Yes | 20 | 55.00 | 225.00 |
| Specialty Glass Build | No | 30 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Specialty Shape Build | No | 40 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Impact-Rated Build | No | 50 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Architectural Wood Build | No | 60 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays.

## Notes to the price list

- Where expedite is unavailable, the expedite lead time shown equals the class standard lead time and the fee and minimum read 0.00; no expedite can be bought in those classes.
- **Fee waived when missed** — yes in every class: the expedite fee is waived when the order ships after its expedited target date.
- The smallest expedite fee is a per-order figure.

## Points of reading

- Only the Custom Size Build and Custom Color Build classes sell an expedited build.
- Hypothetical example: a Custom Size Build expedite requested on a Monday, with no federal holiday in the following three weeks, has an expedited target ship date 12 business days later, on the Wednesday two weeks after the request.
